findings.body: This previous finding remains open. Failed checks override readiness without comparing the PR's headRefOid with the local branch head. After a local repair commit, failures from the previous push still make tasks and fixes show checks failed and recommend forge work instead of forge close. Both machine views use this helper. Keep displaying the PR checks, but apply their failure to local readiness only when they describe the current head.
findings.title: Ignore previous-head failures when deriving the local next step

findings.body: This previous finding remains open. The machine board obtains only open PRs and passes an empty merged-PR set to the story lookup; task and fix rows recognize merges only through the previously fetched landed state. A GitHub merge can therefore leave the board advertising the previous stage and merge command. The text path already obtains merged branches at src/forge/nextstep.py:189 and applies them to fixes at lines 208–209 and tasks at lines 506–516. Use that evidence consistently for board rows and story next steps.
findings.title: Recognize GitHub merges before the default branch is fetched

findings.body: This previous finding remains open. live contains only runs without an end record, so another attempt overwrites started_at with its own start and resets the stage timer. Claude and Codex commit nudges launch additional runs within the same round at src/forge/worker.py:193–199 and 212–219; review retries do likewise at src/forge/review.py:473–478. Build and Review lose elapsed time during the additional attempt, then jump back when the aggregate timing is recorded. Anchor each stage to its first recorded start in the current round while retaining the active worker's own start.
findings.title: Preserve the live stage's start across attempts in one round
